title: Monthly GAAP Close & Financial Verification
reference_docs: QuickBooks Online (general ledger / system of record); ASC 606 (revenue recognition); ASC 842 (leases, if applicable); Exos cap table; lender / loan statements; EXOS-ADM-002 Expense Report Submission.
objective: establish the standard monthly close so Exos's books are maintained on a GAAP (accrual) basis, reconciled, and verifiable for management and investor due diligence.
overview: QuickBooks Online is the single general ledger and system of record; this close is performed in QBO on the accrual basis and the period is LOCKED when complete. Mission Control provides read-only verification (automated tie-outs and exception flags) on top of QBO - it is not a second ledger. Target close: within 10 business days of month-end.

tasks.name: 1. Cutoff & Transaction Completeness
steps: Confirm all vendor bills (AP), customer invoices (AR), Divvy / credit-card charges, and expense reports for the period are entered.
Confirm payroll for the period is fully recorded, including employer taxes and benefits.
Verify transaction cutoff: revenues and expenses are booked in the period earned / incurred (accrual), not when cash moved.
Categorize and clear all uncategorized and undeposited-funds transactions.

tasks.name: 2. Cash Reconciliations
steps: Reconcile every bank account in QBO to the bank statement; investigate and clear reconciling items.
Reconcile every credit card (Divvy) and confirm all receipts are captured.
Confirm ending book cash ties to the bank balances.

tasks.name: 3. Balance Sheet Reconciliations
steps: AR: tie the aging to the GL; reserve or write off uncollectible balances.
AP: tie the aging to the GL; confirm no missing or duplicate liabilities.
Prepaid expenses: update the schedule and record the period amortization.
Fixed assets: record additions / disposals and the monthly depreciation entry.
Accrued liabilities: accrue payroll, PTO, interest, and known unbilled costs.
Debt / notes: tie principal to lender statements and record accrued interest.
Equity: reconcile to the cap table (SAFEs / convertibles, common / preferred, option pool).

tasks.name: 4. Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)
steps: Review active contracts; identify the performance obligations and milestones.
Recognize revenue for obligations satisfied in the period; defer the remainder.
Roll forward deferred revenue / contract liabilities and confirm the balance.
Flag any launch-service or milestone payments requiring judgment for CFO review.

tasks.name: 5. Review & Analytical Verification
steps: Generate the P&L, Balance Sheet, and Statement of Cash Flows on the accrual basis.
Run month-over-month and budget-vs-actual variance (flux) analysis on material accounts; document the explanations.
Confirm the trial balance is in balance and every reconciliation is complete and signed off.

tasks.name: 6. Close, Sign-off & Distribution
steps: CFO reviews and approves the completed close.
Lock the period in QuickBooks Online so history cannot change.
Publish the monthly financial statements to the Series A data room / investor reporting.
Record completion; log any exceptions and corrective actions to carry into the next close.

remarks: GAAP close performed in QBO (accrual). Target: 10 business days post month-end. Mission Control runs read-only verification (tie-outs / exception flags) on the QBO Reports API feed - not a second ledger. For investor-grade assurance, layer a CPA review (SSARS 21) on top; upgrade to a full audit only if a lead investor requires it.
